description: This file defines the PdfType0Font class, which represents a composite font (Type0) used in PDF documents within the PDFsharp library. It manages font descriptors, encoding, descendant fonts, and Unicode mappings, facilitating the embedding and usage of Unicode fonts in PDFs.

classes.name: PdfType0Font
classes.description: Represents a composite (Type 0) font in PDF, supporting Unicode glyph encoding and font embedding functionalities.

methods.description: Constructor initializing a PdfType0Font with a PdfDocument.

methods.description: Constructor creating a Type 0 font from font data and encoding details.

methods.name: PrepareForSave
methods.description: Prepares font data, such as glyph widths and mappings, for saving into a PDF file.
